views.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_pack_drafts_latest_v1
views.definition:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (canonical_product_id) id,
    canonical_product_id,
    matched_etsy_listing_id,
    product_slug,
    pack_version,
    source_brief_version,
    output_contract_version,
    status,
    review_status,
    source_mode,
    source_decision_id,
    seo_title,
    h1,
    meta_description,
    intro,
    bullet_highlights,
    faq,
    image_alt_candidates,
    internal_linking_hints,
    product_truth_snapshot,
    manual_focus_snapshot,
    keyword_roles_snapshot,
    metrics_status_snapshot,
    qa_self_report,
    similarity_check_snapshot,
    agent_input_snapshot,
    agent_output_snapshot,
    validation_result_snapshot,
    human_review_notes,
    reviewer,
    reviewed_at,
    created_by,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    archived_at
   FROM feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1 d
  WHERE archived_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY canonical_product_id, created_at DESC;

views.name: feya_commerce_v_seo_pack_review_queue_v1
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    canonical_product_id,
    matched_etsy_listing_id,
    product_slug,
    status,
    review_status,
    source_mode,
    seo_title,
    h1,
    meta_description,
    COALESCE(metrics_status_snapshot ->> 'status'::text, 'missing'::text) AS metrics_status,
    COALESCE(validation_result_snapshot ->> 'status'::text, 'not_checked'::text) AS validation_status,
    COALESCE(qa_self_report ->> 'similarity_cannibalization'::text, 'not_checked'::text) AS similarity_status,
    COALESCE(qa_self_report ->> 'image_alt_truth'::text, 'not_checked'::text) AS image_alt_status,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    reviewed_at
   FROM feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1 d
  WHERE archived_at IS NULL AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['draft_generated'::text, 'needs_human_review'::text, 'changes_requested'::text, 'approved_draft'::text, 'needs_similarity_check'::text, 'needs_image_alt_review'::text]))
  ORDER BY updated_at DESC;

constraints.name: feya_commerce_seo_pack_drafts_v1_publish_guard_chk
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> 'ready_for_publish'::text) OR ((review_status = 'approved'::text) AND (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (similarity_check_snapshot IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE((similarity_check_snapshot ->> 'status'::text), ''::text) = 'pass'::text) AND (COALESCE((qa_self_report ->> 'image_alt_truth'::text), ''::text) = 'pass'::text) AND (COALESCE((qa_self_report ->> 'component_claim_truth'::text), ''::text) = 'pass'::text) AND (COALESCE((validation_result_snapshot ->> 'status'::text), ''::text) = ANY (ARRAY['valid'::text, 'warning'::text])) AND (jsonb_typeof(COALESCE((validation_result_snapshot -> 'approval_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE((validation_result_snapshot -> 'approval_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) = 0) AND (jsonb_typeof(COALESCE((validation_result_snapshot -> 'product_truth_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length(COALESCE((validation_result_snapshot -> 'product_truth_blockers'::text), '[]'::jsonb)) = 0) AND (cqa_status = ANY (ARRAY['pass'::text, 'pass_with_warnings'::text])) AND (cqa_reviewed_at IS NOT NULL))))

supporting_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feya_fn_execution_request_material_json_v1(p_row feya_growth_execution_requests_v1)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'action_code',p_row.action_code,
    'action_capability_version',p_row.action_capability_version,
    'action_class',p_row.action_class,
    'executor_type',p_row.executor_type,
    'approval_class',p_row.approval_class,
    'mutation_domain',p_row.mutation_domain,
    'target_scope',p_row.target_scope_json,
    'target_version_refs',p_row.target_version_refs_json,
    'request_payload',p_row.request_payload_json,
    'rollback_plan',p_row.rollback_plan_json,
    'postflight_check',p_row.postflight_check_json
  );
$function$
